title: maccms-json
description: One MacCMS server, read over the JSON dialect of its api.php/provide/vod API.

searchable.description: Whether the server searches; absent means it does. A type-50 entry says it here, in `ext.config.searchable`. For a numbered entry the reader fills it in, false only when the entry says `searchable: 0`; a type-50 entry's own `searchable: 0` is what keeps it out of FongMi's search and says nothing about this.
